name: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - CDO
short_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - CDO is on Sunday 18 October 2026 at Limketkai Center in Cagayan de Oro City, over 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - CDO is the Cagayan de Oro leg of the EastWest Bank running series, organised by RUNRIO from Limketkai Center on the National Highway. Race Roster lists a 3:00 AM start. RUNRIO lists 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km and 1 km. Pinoy Fitness gives the top distance as 12 km, but the RUNRIO calendar, the Race Roster race mechanics and the Pinoy Fitness fee table all include a 21 km.

core_facts.city: Cagayan de Oro City, Misamis Oriental

faqs.question: Is there a minimum age for the 21 km at EastWest Dream Run 2026 - CDO?
faqs.answer: Yes. The RUNRIO race mechanics say 21 km participants must be 18 years old or above.

faqs.question: How much does the 21 km cost at EastWest Dream Run 2026 - CDO?
faqs.answer: The 21 km is listed at PHP 1,800 and PHP 2,000 across two price tiers. The 10 km is PHP 1,200 to PHP 1,400, and the 3 km group-of-four entry is PHP 4,000 to PHP 5,000.
